page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.4xlarge is a GPU-accelerated virtual machine powered by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor running at 2.5 GHz under the KVM hypervisor. The platform allocates 16 dedicated vCPUs derived from 8 physical cores with multithreading. System memory is scaled to 120.0 GB, providing an allocation of 7.5 GB per vCPU. Hardware acceleration is driven by two integrated NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPUs, supplying a total of 32 GB VRAM (16 GB per GPU). In addition to baseline network speeds of 5 Gbps, the instance includes 944 GB of bundled local SSD storage for high-speed scratch space.

Benchmark evaluations reveal distinct performance traits shaped by the underlying microarchitecture. Single-threaded stress-ng testing scores 954.09, falling into the lower performance percentile due to base clock constraints and older processor design. In contrast, multi-threaded CPU stress-ng benchmarks reach 9532.02, landing comfortably within the median tier. Memory subsystems demonstrate balanced throughput, recording 56.56 GB/sec for uncached large-block reads and 31.42 GB/sec for writes. In application benchmarks, the server registers 10.88 million Redis SET operations per second and maintains a 9.91 GB/sec throughput for static web serving.

The primary operational tradeoff involves the Pascal GPU architecture and absence of advanced vector extensions like AVX-512, limiting applicability for modern mixed-precision deep learning training. However, the dual-GPU density, high RAM capacity, and bundled local SSD make the configuration cost-effective for legacy CUDA workflows. The instance is suitable for scientific simulations, seismic modeling, offline video transcoding, GPU-based 3D rendering pipelines, and data-caching layers requiring rapid local drive access.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5-c8g1.4xlarge is a dedicated GPU-accelerated compute instance designed for parallel compute and memory-intensive tasks. Driven by an Intel Xeon E5-2682 v4 processor at 2.5 GHz, the configuration delivers 16 vCPUs (8 physical cores) alongside 120.0 GB of system memory. Specialized acceleration is provided by two bundled NVIDIA Pascal P100 GPUs with 32 GB total VRAM, supplemented by 944 GB of local SSD storage and a 5 Gbps baseline network capacity. Benchmark measurements place multi-threaded CPU throughput and uncached memory operations firmly in the middle performance tier, despite modest single-thread execution speeds. Lacking modern tensor cores, the platform trades bleeding-edge AI acceleration for cost-efficient compute density in standard FP32 and FP64 workloads. This instance fits scientific computing, legacy CUDA processing, batch rendering, and data analysis tasks benefiting from onboard SSD storage.
